title: Creator Studio Walkthrough
subtitle: Draft fast, grade, and save the best version

scenes.caption: Open Creator Studio and show the fast draft workspace.
scenes.narration: Creator Studio is the quick drafting room. Start with a rough idea, choose the format and voice, generate options, then grade the result.

scenes.caption: Save the best idea.
scenes.narration: If the draft is strong, save it to the Idea Bank so the best version does not disappear.
